description.default: Professional multi-cloud backup & snapshot management for S3 (AWS, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, OSS, COS) & WebDAV (Jianguoyun, Nextcloud, Synology). Supports auto-backup, AES-256 encryption, and one-click restore.
description.zh_CN: 更强大的第三方云端备份管理插件：原生支持 S3 (MinIO, R2, AWS, 阿里/腾讯/华为云) 与 WebDAV (坚果云, Nextcloud, 群晖)。支持定时自动备份、AES-256 端到端加密、云端历史快照管理与一键下载还原。
